description: A murky, bubbling pool of expired apple juice and marsh weed. The air smells strongly of fermentation and vinegar. A giant banana stands near the bank.

exit_west.description: A gate on the west bank opening back to the Scary Scrapyard.

swamp_wall.description: Dense, tangled walls of swamp bramble and petrified apple branches.

swamp_bank.description: A muddy earthen bank at the edge of the apple juice swamp. It's sticky underfoot.

floor.description: Slightly muddy, sticky ground near the swamp edge.

swamp_pool.description: Deep, bubbling pools of fermented apple juice. Far too sticky to walk through.

future_banana.description: A giant banana. He seems completely out of place in this swamp.

dialogue.text: "Excellent question, I teleported," says the giant banana. "Well, I'm actually from the future, where I am Fred! I was about to die, so I traveled to the past and landed here." Willy looks unimpressed: "This is ridiculous. Banana guy, do you have any way to cross?"

"Oh, I do!" the banana replies. The giant banana lays on his side, forming a fleshy, yellow bridge across the expired apple juice! "That is so disgusting!" you yell. "Well, do you see any other way to cross?" responds the banana.
"Hurry up and cross!" the giant banana sighs. "Before I turn into brown banana bread!"

banana_bridge.description: The back of a giant banana lying across the swamp. It's surprisingly stable but squishy.

conditions.failMessage: The giant banana is still standing — there's no bridge yet! Talk to the Future Banana first.

swamp_hollow.description: A hollow in a petrified tree trunk. Safe from the sticky mud.

exit_east.description: A small mud trail on the east bank leading out of the swamp towards a cultivated field.

conditions.failMessage: The expired apple juice is too deep and sticky to exit east! Talk to the Future Banana to get him to act as a bridge first.
